auth_helper_definitions.es_personal:
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.usuarios u
 WHERE u.auth_id = auth.uid() AND u.activo = true);
auth_helper_definitions.patient_birthday_months:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM fecha_nacimiento)::int AS month, count(*)::bigint AS count
 FROM public.pacientes
 WHERE fecha_nacimiento IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1;
